## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any relevant issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run test:ui` after building (renderer or packaging changes)
- [ ] Packaged executable tested with `SWITCHOID_EXECUTABLE` (packaging changes)

Include screenshots for UI changes and state any checks not run. Check both themes, reduced motion, and the minimum supported window size when affected.

Confirm that no private media, credentials, generated installers, or caches are included. Dependency/engine changes should include license and source provenance updates.
